DEFINE
	VAR __LabTag = "run=20261113T084411Z-v00-4f8b;page=p20;visual=v20;mode=cold;conc=xmla;rep=1"
	VAR __DS0Core =
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(ROLLUPGROUP('Product'[Category], 'Product'[Category Code]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"), ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL('Customer'[Continent], "IsGrandTotalColumnTotal"), "v__Orders", 'Sales'[# Orders])
	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed =
		TOPN(102, SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Product'[Category], 'Product'[Category Code], [IsGrandTotalRowTotal]), [IsGrandTotalRowTotal], 0, 'Product'[Category Code], 1, 'Product'[Category], 1)
	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase =
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Customer'[Continent], [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal])
	VAR __DS0Secondary =
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 1, 'Customer'[Continent], 1)
	VAR __DS0BodyLimited =
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(__DS0PrimaryWindowed, SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(__DS0Core, "ColumnIndex", __DS0Secondary, [IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], ASC, 'Customer'[Continent], ASC))
EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary
ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalColumnTotal], 'Customer'[Continent]
EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited
ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC, 'Product'[Category Code], 'Product'[Category], [ColumnIndex]
